The '''Gran Protectorate Act''' was an act passed by the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] in [[1000 BBY/Legends|1000 BBY]], establishing the [[Gran Protectorate/Legends|Gran Protectorate]] on the planet [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]], effectively ceding the world to the [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] colonists. As a result of the Act, unemployed [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] natives were banished to the world's [[Malastare's western continent|western continent]].
